body.name: Exact \(J=2,s=1\) rational separation certificate
body.construction: Order assignment orbits as \((0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,0),(1,1),(2,0)\) and set \(q^{\mathrm U}=(36,30,1,30,2,1)/100\). Order \(\mathcal H_{2,1}\) lexicographically as specified by \(\pi^{\mathrm U}\), use its displayed 38 rational coordinates, and set \(\eta^{\mathrm U}_{no}=c_{no}(\pi^{\mathrm U})/a_{no}(\pi^{\mathrm U})\) on positive-mass cells and zero otherwise. Use the displayed 38 rational coordinates of \(\pi^{\mathrm H}\) for the canonical-segment lower certificate.
